technologyStack.backend: ASP.NET Core Web API 7.0, MediatR, CQRS, C#

architectureAndDesignPatterns: Clean Architecture with 4 concentric layers (Domain -> Application -> Infrastructure -> Api)
CQRS pattern using MediatR IRequest<TResponse> and IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse>
Secure JWT Bearer authentication with token validation handlers
Angular Standalone Components with Reactive Forms and AuthService
solidPrinciples: Single Responsibility: Separate LoginCommand and LoginCommandHandler
Dependency Inversion: Decouple JWT creation and user persistence via IJwtTokenService and IIdentityService
securityPractices: 5 failed login attempts trigger a 15-minute account lockout
Prevent user enumeration by returning generic 'Invalid credentials' on failed logins
Store password hashes using secure ASP.NET Core PasswordHasher / Argon2 / PBKDF2 with salt
Issue signed JWT tokens with standard claims (sub, email, roles, jti, exp)
